roles.CAL_adaptation: extra30 per class, excluded from gradients and checkpoint selection

inference.unit: paired optimizer/mask block conditional on one graph and the predeclared allocation law
inference.primary_endpoint: raw served accuracy difference in percentage points
inference.primary_test: one-sided paired t of mean delta >0; Holm familywise .05 across eligible two/four contrasts, eligible set frozen before Computers outcome
inference.assumptions: approximately independent, reasonably behaved paired block differences for t procedure; sign symmetry/exchangeability for sign-flip sensitivity; graph population and masks do not create independent graph replication
inference.all_block_signs_for_original_gates: apply original all-block statements to all ten confirmation blocks
inference.additional_gates: retain every admitted panel native practical competence/quality/member/risk/attribution/retention threshold and full controls; positive primary inference alone is insufficient

sign_aware_primary.type: complete development-pilot numeric screen; no confirmatory superiority inference
sign_aware_primary.required_signs: all3paired block differences strictly positive for both served contrasts
sign_aware_primary.capable_quality_screen: candidate mean rawaccuracy>= each fresh factorM1/I4atbothpositions,bothMS4M1controls,freshsource meanSAGE and equally sign-coupled unsharedI4; report all three complete blockvectors/descriptiveCIs; no significance required versus every reference in3-blockpilot
sign_aware_primary.statistics: ordinary paired descriptive95%intervals/fullvectors;8signflip assignments symmetry sensitivity;1encountered graph,not3independent graphs

sign_aware_attribution.M1_control: report (O4graphSP-O4graphIID)-(MS4graphSP-MS4graphIID); same-size single effect limits ensemble/shared-specific interpretation

peer_feedback.scope: Exploratory three paired protocols on one graph. Complete block vectors/descriptive intervals/eight sign-flip assignments; no confirmatory p claim or node-as-independent replication. A complete useful result earns unused whole-pipeline confirmation priority.
peer_feedback.competent_backbone_precondition: Before a positive shared attribution, F1 and I4 must not reveal material factor-induced competence collapse: F1-source P1 mean accuracy>=-.25pp and no block<-.5pp; I4 mean members-source P1 mean>=-.25pp and no block<-.5pp. Failure is a factorization competence finding, not a rescue to weaker references.
peer_feedback.primary_quality: SX4 raw accuracy mean gain>=.25pp vs S4, P1, PA1, I4 and IA4; each paired block gain>0 against each. SX4-UX4 mean>=0 and no block harm>.25pp; this separate quality comparison needs no significance at3 blocks.
peer_feedback.member_competence: SX4 mean own-member raw accuracy gain>=.25pp vs S4, all3 gains>0; SX4 mean members versus IA4 mean>=-.25pp and no block harm>.5pp. Report worst/all route accuracies too.
peer_feedback.risk: SX4 calibrated DEVELOPMENT_EVAL NLL mean harm<=.02 and each block harm<=.05 against P1, PA1, I4, IA4 and UX4. Raw NLL mean harm<=.02 versus S4, SA4 and IA4. Report full raw/calibrated Brier without a post-result secondary winner.
peer_feedback.mechanism: SX4-SA4 mean raw accuracy>=.10pp, each block>=0 for peer access; SX4-SM4 mean>=.10pp, each block>=0 for donor-before-mean nonlinearity. Failure narrows attribution even if generic feedback is useful. These controls do not prove global novelty or unique optimality.
peer_feedback.retention: Exact coverage/pooling-loss/aggregation-only identity and all candidate-reference repair/harm pairs. SX4 pooling losses count must not exceed S4 or IA4 in the mean per block; otherwise reject a claim that this rule repairs the recorded pooling failure, even if accuracy is useful for another reason. No grouping weights or post hoc subgroup-primary gate.
peer_feedback.after_failure: Close exact rank16/scale.25/site/operator recipe; no rescue coefficient/rank/site grid or old endpoint reinterpretation. No automatic study/source launch. If PA1/IA4/SA4 explain gains, retain attributed generic feature feedback and record shared gate failure.

full_gate_bindings.status: Original thresholds and endpoint meanings; replace three-block/all3 statements by the ten prospective blocks and add the four primary inferential contrasts without removing any control
